project_type: React 18 + TypeScript + Vite SPA inside a Node monorepo
build_system: Vite 5 (each app has its own node_modules — run npm install then build inside the app dir, NOT from the repo root). The root package.json only installs api-gateway. Always cd into apps/operator-dashboard/ before running npm commands.
build_command: cd /run/media/masalago/5a19708f-dc92-4a1e-9cea-08f3109bf2db/projects/daladala/apps/operator-dashboard && npm install --legacy-peer-deps && npm run build
verification_instructions: 1. cd into apps/operator-dashboard/. 2. npm install --legacy-peer-deps (adds missing deps). 3. npm run build — must exit 0 with no TypeScript errors. 4. npm test — must pass (--passWithNoTests so zero tests is fine).
snapshot_or_generated_files: dist/ produced by vite build — do NOT commit dist/.
environment_constraints: Never restart the api-gateway dev server. Work only inside apps/operator-dashboard/. The repo root package.json does NOT workspace-link apps — each app installs its own node_modules.
contribution_requirements: Match driver-dashboard visual patterns exactly: bg-gray-900 sidebar, text-white, blue-600 active nav item, bg-gray-50 main area, white rounded-lg shadow cards. All UI text via i18next t(). Mock data where API is absent — comment // MOCK DATA on those blocks. No TypeScript errors at build time.
key_patterns: 1. Zustand auth store pattern: create<AuthState>() with isAuthenticated from localStorage token check, login() calls POST /auth/login, logout() clears localStorage. See driver-dashboard/src/store/auth.ts. 2. Axios client with Bearer token interceptor + 401→/login redirect. See driver-dashboard/src/services/api.ts. 3. App.tsx uses createBrowserRouter (admin-panel pattern) with <RequireAuth> wrapper around layout+children. Login page is top-level at /login. 4. i18n: inline resources object (not JSON import) in i18n/index.ts, call i18n.use(initReactI18next).init(). See admin-panel/src/i18n.ts. 5. StatCard: props {title, value, icon, color, trend?, subtext?} with colorClasses map. See driver-dashboard/src/components/StatCard.tsx. 6. Sidebar: fixed left w-64 bg-gray-900, navItems map with Link, active = bg-blue-600, footer has Settings+Logout buttons. 7. Auth login endpoint is POST /api/v1/auth/login with body {phone, password} (NOT email). The task says email/password but the actual api-gateway auth.ts uses {phone, password} — use phone field, label it Email in UI but name='phone' so it matches existing users OR accept both and send as phone. Decision: use email label in UI but submit as phone field for operator accounts (operators registered by admin via phone). Actually the task says 'email/password' — add email field to UI but POST as {email, password} since the auth route query is by phone; operators may be created with email as phone. Safest: send {phone: emailValue, password} since that's what auth.ts reads. 8. Leaflet: import 'leaflet/dist/leaflet.css' in index.css or main.tsx; fix default icon with L.Icon.Default.mergeOptions({...}). Use react-leaflet MapContainer, TileLayer (OSM), Marker, Popup. 9. CSV export: build a data URI from array of objects and trigger <a download>.
directory_structure: apps/operator-dashboard/ — target app, currently only package.json + tsconfig.json. apps/driver-dashboard/src/ — visual template (Sidebar, StatCard, api.ts, store/auth.ts, pages/). apps/admin-panel/src/ — auth routing template (createBrowserRouter, RequireAuth, i18n). services/api-gateway/src/routes/ — backend endpoint implementations. packages/shared-types/ — shared TS types (referenced via tsconfig paths).
